derivation: or חֻשִׁים; or חֻשִׁם; plural from H2363 (חוּשׁ); hasters;
def: Chushim, the name of three Israelites

occurrences.text: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
